text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Kiseki and I
happened to pass by a beautiful park.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, what a great location!
I was just looking for reference material
with this exact kind of background!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you mind if I take a quick look around?
Ah, only if you're not in a hurry, of course...!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, let's take our time and look around!

text_block_list.text:
Kiseki took a bunch of photos and even started sketching on the spot.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Air Groove-senpai!
Good work! Are you out for a run?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kiseki. What a coincidence.
Are you drawing manga again?
You're as skilled as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, getting praised by my senpai is the best~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but this flower might not be the best.
I somehow can't quite understand its structure..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that rose.
It's certainly hard to tell when it's only half in bloom.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That blooming style is called a button eye; the center petals curl in and form a dense cluster. It has a tighter, firmer texture...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see...!?
Is it something like this?!
Ah, and when viewed from an angle, it looks like this~...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes... That's it... Indeed!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that great?
It feels so much more realistic now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thank you so much!
Advice from an expert is super helpful!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiight! I've got it!
Time to draw like crazy~~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Quick on the uptake, just as expected.

A short distance away, Kiseki was engrossed in sketching.
Air Groove watched her with an amused look.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—She's straightforward, isn't she?
Even if she falls, she gets right back up and starts running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She's a student worth teaching.
That cheerfulness and honesty are rare and wonderful virtues.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The world of racing is harsh.
That is why some stubbornly put on a brave face
and try to carry everything on their own.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Some folks are clumsy, have no hobbies,
and are just terrible at unwinding.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In that regard, she's flexible.
Could it be the influence of her "creative work"?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A mentality fostered through creation...
Could this be a hint for mentoring juniors...?
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, as expected, it's difficult.
While there are cases of incorporating art
as a form of mental training...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Creating something from nothing
is not something just anyone can do.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Air Groove-senpaaaai!
Take thiiis~~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da!
I designed a new character modeled after you, Senpai!
I'll send it to your phone later!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you... supposed to be
sketching?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Man, it just came to me all of a sudden!
Once you get excited, there's no stopping, right?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......
Excited, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
You're the kind of person who'd start running on just that alone.
That's what makes you so fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keep up that momentum, and I expect
you'll entertain everyone in the race as well.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oho! Um! I'll do my best in both manga and races!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Aahhh~! I got such a great drawing done!
I'm so glad we got to meet Air Groove-senpai!

Kiseki looks so delighted.
Her heartfelt feelings are clearly conveyed through her expression.
choice_data_list: You really respect them, don't you?
You two get along so well!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You're right! After all, she's an amazing Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She does seem like a main character...
No, from where I'm standing...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Maybe something like, "The protagonist from the previous game became a super dependable, insanely strong ally!"

Using that analogy, Kiseki happily
continued talking about Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, does it look that way to you!?
Ehehe, you're making me blush~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I think so too.
She even lets me watch her training sometimes!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to live up to your expectations, Senpai.
Someday, I want my races
to fill you with excitement!"

Kiseki's eyes were sparkling—
no, just like in a manga, they were blazing with fiery determination.
